settings.label: Account ID
settings.meaning: The Zoom account the app acts in. Sent with every token request.
settings.whereToFind: Zoom App Marketplace › Developers › Build an app › Server-to-Server OAuth app › App credentials. Zoom has no sandbox or test keys: use a separate app (or account) for test.

settings.label: Client ID
settings.meaning: The Server-to-Server OAuth app's client id. Not a secret on its own, but only useful with the client secret.
settings.whereToFind: The same app's App credentials page. The app must be activated (Activation) with its scopes added (Scopes) before it can get a token.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.meaning: The Server-to-Server OAuth app's client secret: with the client id, it gets the account's access tokens.
settings.whereToFind: The same app's App credentials page, under the client id.

settings.label: Webhook secret token
settings.meaning: Checks that a webhook came from Zoom, and answers Zoom's check that the endpoint is the app's. Only for receiving events.
settings.whereToFind: The same app's Feature page (Features › Access), with Event Subscriptions: the Secret Token.

operations.name: oauth.token
operations.purpose: Gets an access token by the account credentials grant: POST https://zoom.us/oauth/token?grant_type=account_credentials&account_id=<accountId> with Basic auth of the client id and secret. It lasts an hour and there is no refresh token: keep it until shortly before expires_in, then ask again. A new token doesn't invalidate the old one.

operations.name: meetings.create
operations.purpose: Schedules a meeting hosted by a user (their id or email; a Server-to-Server app doesn't use `me`). Zoom takes no idempotency key, so it isn't retried after an outage: a retry could make a second meeting. Zoom allows 100 creates and updates per host per day (UTC).

operations.name: meetings.get
operations.purpose: Reads one meeting by its id: its join link, time and settings. Also how the host's start link is read fresh, since it expires after two hours.

operations.name: meetings.update
operations.purpose: Changes a meeting's topic, time, duration or settings; fields left out are kept.

operations.name: meetings.delete
operations.purpose: Deletes a meeting, or one occurrence of a recurring one.

operations.name: meetings.list
operations.purpose: Lists a user's meetings (scheduled, live, upcoming or previous), a page at a time by next_page_token.

operations.name: pastMeetings.get
operations.purpose: Reads a meeting that has happened, by id (its latest instance) or by an instance's UUID: when it started and ended, and how many took part.

operations.name: pastMeetings.participants
operations.purpose: Lists who took part in a past meeting, a page at a time by next_page_token. Paid accounts only.

operations.name: recordings.get
operations.purpose: Reads a meeting's cloud recordings, by id (its latest instance) or an instance's UUID: each file with its type and download URL.

operations.name: recordings.download
operations.purpose: Downloads a recording or transcript file from its download_url (on zoom.us), with the access token as a Bearer token. The URL may redirect.

operations.name: transcripts.get
operations.purpose: Reads a meeting's transcript, by id (its latest instance) or an instance's UUID: whether it can be downloaded yet, and its download URL.

operations.name: users.get
operations.purpose: Reads one user of the account by id or email: their name, email, time zone and status.

signature.description: x-zm-signature is v0= followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the secret token, of v0:<x-zm-request-timestamp>:<raw body>. The timestamp is Unix seconds; refuse one more than five minutes from now. Zoom first checks the endpoint with a signed POST whose body is {"event":"endpoint.url_validation","payload":{"plainToken":"…"}}: answer within 3 seconds with 200 and {"plainToken":"…","encryptedToken":<hex HMAC-SHA256 of plainToken, keyed with the secret token>}. Zoom repeats the check every 72 hours.

events.meaning: Zoom checking that the endpoint is the app's, when it's set and every 72 hours. Answered by the authenticator; never reaches the route.
